label: ABC4_hP18_152_a_b_2c-001
title: Alarsite (AlAsO$_{4}$) Structure
comments:
This structure is \href{current_web_home_dir/Tutorials/ChiralSpaceGroups/index.html#ClassII}{chiral, Sohncke Class II}, and so may also be found in the enantiomorphic space group $P3_{2}21$ \#154. 
 The ICSD designates AlPO$_{4}$ berlinite as the prototype structure. 
 There is a very close relationship between \href{current_web_home_dir/Tutorials/SiO2_AlPO4#AlPO4}{this structure and $\alpha$-quartz}. 
 See the \href{current_web_home_dir/Tutorials/SiO2_AlPO4}{silica and aluminum phosphate page} for more information on these structures.
